links.outcome: Accuracy of chatbot responses on pediatric dental sedation against clinical guidelines
links.effect: Gemini and ChatGPT-4o highest accuracy; Copilot lowest with highest guideline deviation; none of the chatbots fully aligned with clinical guidelines or consistently achieved high accuracy across all phases.
links.quote: Despite the fact that ChatGPT-4o and Gemini exhibited superior performance in general, none of the evaluated chatbots fully aligned with clinical guidelines or consistently achieved high accuracy across all phases.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the accuracy, quality, and readability of responses from multiple LLMs to pediatric dental sedation questions without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
